content.hi:
CBSE Class 10 Board Exam mein Some Applications of Trigonometry se kitne marks aate hain?
📊 Total Weightage: ~6-8 marks
📝 1-mark questions: Basic definition ya simple value
📝 2-mark questions: Simple height/distance nikaalna
📝 3-mark questions: Two points ya moving observer
📝 4-mark questions: Complex problem with two buildings/objects
🎯 Important: Diagram banaana sabse zaroori hai — bina diagram ke 0 marks!
content.en:
How many marks does Some Applications of Trigonometry carry in CBSE Class 10 Board Exam?
📊 Total Weightage: ~6-8 marks
📝 1-mark questions: Basic definition or simple value
📝 2-mark questions: Simple height/distance finding
📝 3-mark questions: Two points or moving observer
📝 4-mark questions: Complex problem with two buildings/objects
🎯 Important: Drawing diagram is most crucial — without it, 0 marks!

content.hi:
Yeh questions har saal exam mein aate hain:
Q1. Angle of Elevation tab hota hai jab object observer se ______ hai.  [Ans: Upar/Above]
Q2. Angle of Depression = Angle of ______ (same horizontal level pe).  [Ans: Elevation]
Q3. Height nikaalne ke liye sabse zyada kaunsa ratio use hota hai?  [Ans: tan θ]
Q4. Jab observer object ki taraf move karta hai, toh angle of elevation ______ hota hai.  [Ans: Badhta hai/Increases]
Q5. Ek pole 10m high hai aur uski shadow 10m hai. Sun ka angle = ?  [Ans: 45°]
Q6. Kite ki string 100m hai aur angle 30° hai. Kite ki height = ?  [Ans: 50m]
Q7. tan 45° = ?  [Ans: 1]
Q8. Depression angle hamesha 0° se ______ ke beech hota hai.  [Ans: 90°]
content.en:
These questions appear in the exam every year:
Q1. Angle of Elevation occurs when object is ______ the observer.  [Ans: Above]
Q2. Angle of Depression = Angle of ______ (at same horizontal level).  [Ans: Elevation]
Q3. Which ratio is most used to find height and distance?  [Ans: tan θ]
Q4. When observer moves towards object, angle of elevation ______.  [Ans: Increases]
Q5. A pole 10m high has shadow 10m. Sun's angle = ?  [Ans: 45°]
Q6. Kite string 100m, angle 30°. Kite height = ?  [Ans: 50m]
Q7. tan 45° = ?  [Ans: 1]
Q8. Depression angle is always between 0° and ______.  [Ans: 90°]

content.hi: 💡 Tip: Objective questions mein direct formula use karo — time bachao!
content.en: 💡 Tip: In objective questions, use direct formula — save time!

content.hi:
Board exam ke liye ye questions practice karo:
📌 Ek 15m high pole ki shadow 5√3 m hai. Sun ka angle of elevation nikaalo. [2M]
📌 Ek kite 60m high udi hui hai aur string ka angle 60° hai. String ki length nikaalo. [2M]
📌 Ek tower ke base se 30m door angle 30° hai aur 10m aur paas aane pe 60°. Tower ki height. [3M]
📌 Ek building ke top se car ka depression 60° hai aur bottom se car ka elevation 30° hai. Building ki height. [3M]
📌 Do buildings 50m aur 30m high hain. Choti building ke top se badi building ka elevation 30° hai. Distance nikaalo. [3M]
📌 Ek plane 1500m height mein hai. Ground ke ek point se plane ka elevation 60° hai. Plane kitna door hai? [2M]
📌 Ek tower pe flagstaff hai. Tower ke base se tower top ka elevation 45° aur flagstaff top ka 60°. Tower 20m hai. Flagstaff ki height. [4M]
📌 Ek lighthouse 80m high hai. Do ships same side mein hain with depression angles 30° and 60°. Ships ke beech ka distance. [4M]
content.en:
Practice these questions for the board exam:
📌 A 15m high pole has shadow 5√3 m. Find sun's angle of elevation. [2M]
📌 A kite is 60m high with string angle 60°. Find string length. [2M]
📌 From 30m away, tower angle is 30°. After moving 10m closer, angle is 60°. Find height. [3M]
📌 From building top, car depression is 60°; from bottom, car elevation is 30°. Find building height. [3M]
📌 Two buildings 50m and 30m high. From shorter building top, taller building elevation is 30°. Find distance. [3M]
📌 A plane at 1500m height has ground elevation 60°. How far is the plane? [2M]
📌 Tower with flagstaff. Tower 20m high. Tower top elevation 45°, flagstaff top 60°. Find flagstaff height. [4M]
📌 A lighthouse 80m high. Two ships same side with depression angles 30° and 60°. Find distance between ships. [4M]

content.hi: In questions ko 2-3 baar practice karo — pattern same rehta hai, sirf numbers change hote hain!
content.en: Practice these questions 2-3 times — pattern remains same, only numbers change!

problem.hi: Ek tower ke top pe ek flagstaff laga hai. Tower ke base se flagstaff ke top ka angle of elevation 60° hai aur tower ke top ka angle of elevation 45° hai. Agar tower 10m high hai, toh flagstaff ki height nikaalo. (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: A flagstaff stands on top of a tower. From the base of the tower, the angle of elevation of the top of the flagstaff is 60° and that of the top of the tower is 45°. If the tower is 10m high, find the height of the flagstaff. (√3 = 1.732)

steps.hi: Do alag-alag angles → do equations → pehle d nikaalo, phir h!
steps.en: Two different angles → two equations → first find d, then h!

problem.hi: Ek 100m high lighthouse ke base se do ships opposite sides mein hain. Ek ship ka angle of elevation 30° hai aur doosre ka 45° hai. Dono ships ke beech ka distance nikaalo. (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: From the base of a 100m high lighthouse, two ships are on opposite sides. One ship has angle of elevation 30° and the other 45°. Find the distance between the two ships. (√3 = 1.732)

steps.hi: 🎯 Opposite sides mein distances ADD karte hain, same side mein SUBTRACT!
steps.en: 🎯 Opposite sides → ADD distances, same side → SUBTRACT!

problem.hi: Ek 20m high building ke top se ek cloud ka angle of elevation 30° hai aur uske reflection (water mein) ka angle of depression 60° hai. Cloud ki height nikaalo. (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: From the top of a 20m high building, the angle of elevation of a cloud is 30° and the angle of depression of its reflection in water is 60°. Find the height of the cloud. (√3 = 1.732)

steps.hi: Let cloud height above ground = H
steps.en: Let cloud height above ground = H

steps.hi: Reflection ground se neeche H meter hai
steps.en: Reflection is H meters below ground

steps.hi: Reflection se building top ki vertical distance = H + 20
steps.en: Reflection to building top vertical distance = H + 20

steps.hi: Reflection problems mein: Cloud height above building aur reflection depth below building dono use karo!
steps.en: In reflection problems: Use cloud height above building AND reflection depth below building!

problem.hi: Ek ladder deewar (wall) se 60° ka angle banati hai. Agar ladder ka base wall se 5m door hai, to ladder ki length nikaalo. (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: A ladder makes an angle of 60° with the ground against a wall. If the foot of the ladder is 5m from the wall, find the length of the ladder. (√3 = 1.732)

steps.hi: Wall se distance (base) = 5m, angle with ground = 60°
steps.en: Distance from wall (base) = 5m, angle with ground = 60°

steps.hi: Base aur hypotenuse involve hain, isliye cos use karo:
steps.en: Base and hypotenuse are involved, so use cos:

steps.hi: 🎯 Base + Hypotenuse diye ho to cos use karo; Perpendicular + Base ho to tan; Perpendicular + Hypotenuse ho to sin!
steps.en: 🎯 When Base + Hypotenuse are given, use cos; Perpendicular + Base, use tan; Perpendicular + Hypotenuse, use sin!

problem.hi: Ek 60m high building ke top se doosre building ke top ka angle of depression 30° hai aur doosre building ke bottom ka angle of depression 60° hai. Doosri building ki height aur dono buildings ke beech ka distance nikaalo. (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: From the top of a 60m high building, the angle of depression of the top of another building is 30° and the angle of depression of its bottom is 60°. Find the height of the second building and the distance between them. (√3 = 1.732)

steps.hi: Do triangles: ek ground level ke liye, ek top-to-top ke liye!
steps.en: Two triangles: one for ground level, one for top-to-top!

question.hi: Height aur Distance nikaalne ke liye sabse zyada kaunsa ratio use hota hai?
question.en: Which ratio is most used to find height and distance?

explanation.hi: tan θ = Height/Distance, isliye jab height aur distance dono involved ho toh tan θ use karte hain.
explanation.en: tan θ = Height/Distance, so when both height and distance are involved, we use tan θ.

question.hi: Ek tower 20m high hai. Base se 20m door angle of elevation kitna hoga?
question.en: A tower is 20m high. From a point 20m away, what is the angle of elevation?

question.hi: Ek kite 50m high hai aur string ka angle 30° hai. String ki length kya hai?
question.en: A kite is 50m high and string makes 30° with ground. What is the string length?

question.hi: Angle of Depression hamesha Angle of Elevation se bada hota hai.
question.en: Angle of Depression is always greater than Angle of Elevation.

explanation.hi: Dono equal ho sakte hain (alternate angles), lekin hamesha nahi. Situation pe depend karta hai.
explanation.en: They can be equal (alternate angles), but not always greater. Depends on situation.

question.hi: Ek 30m high building ke top se ground ka angle of depression 60° hai. Ground kitni door hai?
question.en: A 30m high building has ground depression 60°. How far is the ground?

question.hi: Do ships opposite sides mein hain. Ek ka elevation 30° aur doosre ka 45°. Lighthouse 100m high hai. Total distance kya hoga?
question.en: Two ships on opposite sides. One elevation 30°, other 45°. Lighthouse 100m high. Total distance?

question.hi: Ek tower ke base se angle 30° hai. 20m aur paas aane pe 60° hai. Tower ki height kya hai?
question.en: From a tower's base, angle is 30° at 30m. After moving 20m closer, angle is 60°. What is the height?

question.hi: Heights & Distances problems solve karne ke liye sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?
question.en: What is the first step to solve Heights & Distances problems?

explanation.hi: Bina diagram ke galat ho sakta hai. Hamesha pehle diagram banao!
explanation.en: Without diagram, you can go wrong. Always draw diagram first!

notes.hi: ✅ Line of Sight = Observer se Object tak ki straight line
notes.en: ✅ Line of Sight = Straight line from Observer's eye to Object

notes.hi: ✅ Angle of Elevation = Object UPAR hai
notes.en: ✅ Angle of Elevation = Object is ABOVE

notes.hi: ✅ Angle of Depression = Object NEECHE hai
notes.en: ✅ Angle of Depression = Object is BELOW

notes.hi: ✅ Two points same side: Distance subtract (d₂ - d₁)
notes.en: ✅ Two points same side: Subtract distances (d₂ - d₁)

notes.hi: ✅ Two points opposite side: Distance add (d₁ + d₂)
notes.en: ✅ Two points opposite side: Add distances (d₁ + d₂)

notes.hi: ✅ Moving observer: Height same → equations equal
notes.en: ✅ Moving observer: Height same → equate equations

notes.hi: ✅ Two buildings: Vertical distance between tops use karo
notes.en: ✅ Two buildings: Use vertical distance between tops

notes.hi: ✅ Reflection problems: Cloud height + Reflection depth
notes.en: ✅ Reflection problems: Cloud height + Reflection depth
